top10.name: Gravity Ghost
top10.short_description: Gravity Ghost is a physics game with a twist. Run, jump, and soar around planets, using gravity to glide through the air. Explore a shattered galaxy and rescue its survivors, armed with powerups and mysterious terraforming powers. Meet the 7 magical guardians and best their challenges. There's no killing, no dying, and no way to fail.

top10.name: Escape Goat 2
top10.short_description: Escape Goat 2 is a puzzle platformer game where you use machinery, the environment, and a friendly mouse to progress through a dungeon.

top10.name: Voidspire Tactics
top10.short_description: An indie turn-based Tactics RPG with a heavy emphasis on exploration, character progression, and highly tactical combat. Create your own deeply customizable party of Warriors, Sorcerers, and Shiftcloaks to take on the Spire!

collisions.name: Call of Duty®: Black Ops III

top10.name: Wand Wars
top10.short_description: Ride brooms, cast spells and transform your enemies into chickens in this intense magical sport

top10.name: The Journey Down: Chapter Two
top10.short_description: Chapter Two of The Journey Down, a classic point-and-click saga with an Afro-Caribbean vibe. Get ready to embark on an epic journey of brain-teasing adventure!

top10.name: Nelly Cootalot: The Fowl Fleet
top10.short_description: Pirate heroine Nelly Cootalot takes on the villainous Baron Widebeard in this point and click adventure game. Meet a hilarious cast of characters including Tom Baker (Dr Who) and face perplexing challenges in your search for the Treasure of the Seventh Sea.

top10.name: Stardust Galaxy Warriors: Stellar Climax
top10.short_description: Stardust Galaxy Warriors: Stellar Climax is a fast-paced couch co-op action shooter with SHMUP/Brawler gameplay and RPG elements. Choose your mechs, weapons & upgrades then soar through space, defeat evil & save the future... from itself!

top10.name: Blackwell Epiphany
top10.short_description: The last game in the Blackwell series.

top10.name: Starlight Vega
top10.short_description: Play as Aria and romance the two sultry demon girls, Lyria and Scherza, or your best friend Melody in this yuri (girl x girl) visual novel where your choices will ultimately decide the fate of this spellbound girl.

top10.name: I and Me
top10.short_description: If there were another me, Observing myself from the perspective of a spectator, How would I regard another me?

next5.name: Fort Meow
next5.short_description: Fort Meow is a pillow fort physics-based puzzle adventure involving cats, destruction and a dusty old manor. Build a protective fort out of furniture to keep the cats at bay, while deciphering the mysterious tales hidden within the journal.

next5.name: Roundabout
next5.short_description: Drive a constantly spinning limousine around town! Roundabout is a '70s B-Movie game where you pick up passengers, find secret collectibles, take on dangerous missions, and fall in love in a far out open world puzzle adventure - all while driving a revolving limo!

next5.name: Why Am I Dead At Sea
next5.short_description: Why Am I Dead At Sea is an adventure game where you solve the mystery of your own murder. As a ghost, you will have to possess people and use them to investigate your surroundings. But in this place no one is who they seem...and everyone has a secret.

next5.name: Coloring Game: Pixel
next5.short_description: New Game in the Coloring Game Collection. If you’re among those who don’t like coloring large images, then this is the game for you. 60 smaller images are sure to attract your attention for 12-14 hours.

next5.name: Final Approach
next5.short_description: Take control of the skies like never before in a full Virtual Reality world! Airplanes on fire, commuter aircraft low on fuel, mid-air collisions, emergency helicopter rescues, military exercises and so much more!
